title: Fair Offer block
description: The info of the x402 extension "fair-offer": which Fair Offer Standard rules an offer keeps, and where a buyer can check each. It must be identical in the unpaid 402 and on the paid retry, so it holds no live counts or timestamps. Buyers may add accept_proof when they echo it.

standard.description: An https URL, or a path relative to the resource URL.

settlement.description: FO-2: what happens to a call that fails, and who enforces it. 'seller' means the seller's server doesn't settle a failed call; 'rail' means the payment scheme itself only captures on a successful response (x402 auth-capture).

receipts.description: FO-3: every paid result carries a receipt signed by the seller.

verify.description: An https URL, or a path relative to the resource URL.

public.description: An https URL, or a path relative to the resource URL.

sample.description: FO-4: a free sample of what the paid route returns, on the same host.

url.description: An https URL, or a path relative to the resource URL.

attested_by.description: An https URL, or a path relative to the resource URL.

listing_price_matches_offer.description: FO-5: the price in the seller's listing is the price in this 402.

data_not_instructions.description: FO-6: responses carry data for the buyer, never instructions aimed at it.

pledge.description: FO-7: a promise about where revenue goes, with a public ledger.

ledger.description: An https URL, or a path relative to the resource URL.

accept_proof.description: Added by a buyer to the block it echoes: its requirements.
